svg.title: The Pecos test facility as three layouts
svg.desc: Plan view of the Pecos layout. The sandbox_eng and sandbox_qa sections are separate layouts; sandbox_combined is both. Each panel shows the occupancy of that layout's full_start_in_auto scenario file.

g.text: An AGV and a tray on the same stall: the AGV is lowered under the tray (initial_lifted is false unless lift_fraction is 1). Map labels: P17, W22, B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV charger); T17 =

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: tray_id 17; AGV-1 = agv_id 1; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90}, heading in degrees [-179, 180], 90 = facing -x.
